record.question: The _____________ old crow tried to sing. Provide suitable adjective.
record.explanation: Answer A: foolish. “Foolish” best conveys the implied judgment of the crow trying to sing; other adjectives can also grammatically modify crow, so this is a contextual best-fit recommendation. Independent check: “Foolish” is the semantic fit for an old crow trying to sing in the fable-like sentence. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
